name: Chemipro Kasei Kaisha, Ltd.
summary: Chemipro Kasei Kaisha, Ltd. manufactures and sells chemicals and household products in Japan. The company offers plastic additives, including UV absorbers and anti-oxidants; additives for use in commodities and industrial products; developers and functional pigments for use in thermal paper; and pharmaceutical and agricultural intermediates, as well as photographic intermediates. It also provides organic electronic materials (organic EL) and other products used in the development of peripheral materials, such as hole-transporting, electron-transporting, and emitting materials, as well as chemical agents used for organic EL. In addition, the company offers wood preservatives under the ALISIS name, as well as insecticides under the XAMOX name for home termite control; and wood protective coating materials for home centers applications, as well as for treating electricity poles and railroad ties used by Japanese National Railways. Chemipro Kasei Kaisha, Ltd. was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.
